what: PAIRS-ALPACA-BUILD review item 5 (KNOWN live/backtest divergence, by design of PR #17747): with leg_tp: spread_target each leg carries a resting TP at the price where THAT leg alone closes the predicted reversion gap. If one leg's TP fills intraday, the pair is half-open and the next tick's cleanup closes the other leg at market -- an exit the harness (scripts/backtest_pairs.py, close-basis |z| <= exit_z) never takes. It can fire earlier than the harness (intraday touch) and at a different spread. Decide (Tier-3, operator): keep spread_target (doctrine-compliant, divergence measured), or make pairs leg TPs backstop-only (wide) with the spread target carried as a non-resting prediction -- which needs a TP-doctrine ruling for 2-leg sleeves.
